name: Media Hub
description: Turn an article brief into a ready-to-publish image package -- featured image plus inline supporting images, with alt text -- using your own Magnific API key. Supports multiple AI image models (Magnific Mystic, Google Nano Banana Pro/Flash, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, Flux, Seedream and more) plus an automatic 'auto' model picker that matches the model to the image's role and prompt. Google Imagen 4 Ultra/Fast are excluded from selection.

tools.name: create_media_brief
tools.description: Create a new image brief for an article: site, title, summary and how many inline images besides the featured image. Creates the package in draft status -- call generate_media_package next to actually produce the images.

site.description: Which site this article is for, e.g. 'g4s.md'. Free text -- used for filtering, not validated against a connected-sites list.
site.title: Site

summary.description: Short summary of the article's content/angle -- used as the basis for the image prompt(s).
summary.title: Summary

style_direction.description: Optional style guidance, e.g. 'industrial, realistic, no text in image, blue/grey palette'.
style_direction.title: Style Direction

text_policy.description: Whether generated images may render legible in-image text: 'no_text' (default -- clean, text-free compositions) or 'allow_text' (renders the EXACT words given in `image_text` baked into the image, e.g. a price or a comparison label). Content Strategy Hub decides this per brief; an approved Visual Profile that forbids in-image text always overrides an 'allow_text' request. 'allow_text' without a non-empty `image_text` is rejected -- the prompt must always be explicit about EITHER no text OR the specific text, never a vague 'maybe some text'.
text_policy.title: Text Policy

image_text.description: The EXACT short text (a label, price, number, or one-line phrase) the image must legibly render. Required when text_policy='allow_text'; ignored/must be empty for 'no_text'.
image_text.title: Image Text

inline_count.description: How many inline supporting images besides the featured image (0-8).
inline_count.title: Inline Count

model.description: Which model to use for every asset in this brief. Default 'auto' selects a third-party model available through Magnific (e.g. Google Nano Banana Pro/Flash, Gemini, Flux, Seedream) matched to the image's role and prompt. Choose a specific model when needed. Google Imagen 4 Ultra/Fast are not selectable (either automatically or explicitly). Mystic is reserved for the automatic technical-failure fallback or an explicit user choice; it is never the silent default.
model.title: Model

lang.description: The POST's own language code, e.g. 'ru', 'ro', 'en' -- used for alt text/caption wording, which must match the article's language (unlike the image PROMPT, which is always generated in English regardless of this field).
lang.title: Lang

native_title.description: The article title written in the post's OWN language (lang) -- used ONLY to build default alt text/caption. Keep 'article_title' itself in English (it feeds the image prompt, which must stay English); pass the real, native-language title here so alt text/caption come out correct for the post instead of defaulting to English. Omit to fall back to article_title (English default, same as v1 behaviour).
native_title.title: Native Title

MediaAsset.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.

return_schema.description: A brief plus its generated (or in-progress) image assets.

tools.description: Check Magnific's own docs site right now for text-to-image models we don't support yet. Always records the result, whether or not anything new is found -- this is the same check that also runs automatically once a day.

params_schema.description:
No inputs -- this always checks the one known source (Magnific's
own sitemap) against the one known registry (model_registry.MODELS).
params_schema.title: CheckNewModelsParams

ModelDiscoveryFinding.description:
One docs page the sitemap has that model_registry.MODELS doesn't --
a candidate model, NOT yet a usable one (see model_discovery.py for why
this never becomes a ModelSpec by itself).
ModelDiscoveryFinding.title: ModelDiscoveryFinding

return_schema.description: Outcome of one daily/manual check run.
return_schema.title: ModelDiscoveryResult

tools.name: analyze_prompt
tools.description: Score an image prompt against a 6-slot rubric (subject, environment, composition, lighting, style, technical/camera) -- a keyword-presence check, not a quality judgement. Shows exactly which slots the prompt does not mention yet.

prompt.description: The image prompt text to analyze against the 6-slot rubric (subject/environment/composition/lighting/style/technical).
prompt.title: Prompt

return_schema.description:
Result of scoring one prompt -- a keyword-presence heuristic, not a
quality judgement. `score` is 0-100; `missing` names exactly which of
the 6 slots the heuristic found no keyword for.
return_schema.title: PromptAnalysis

tools.name: fix_prompt
tools.description: Deterministically fix a prompt's missing structural slots (lighting, camera/lens, generic style fallback) without inventing subject or scene content. Any subject/environment gap that's still missing after the fix is reported, not guessed -- add real words yourself for those.

prompt.description: The image prompt text to fix.
prompt.title: Prompt

role.description: Asset role this prompt is for -- 'featured' or an inline role -- decides which generic camera clause fits (wide hero vs detail shot).
role.title: Role

return_schema.description:
Outcome of a deterministic fix pass -- only structural slots this
engine is allowed to fill without guessing real content.

unfixable_issues.description: Slots still missing that need real words from a human (e.g. 'subject', 'environment') -- never invented.
unfixable_issues.title: Unfixable Issues

return_schema.title: FixedPrompt

tools.name: check_prompt_engine_updates
tools.description: Manually run the Image Prompt engine's self-review right now (same check that also runs automatically once a month): hash-diffs the vendor prompting guides this engine is built from, and re-scores a sample of this app's own recently generated prompts. Always records the result, whether or not anything changed -- never silently rewrites the engine's own rules.

params_schema.description:
No inputs -- always checks the same 3 vendor guide sources against
their last-known hashes, and re-scores a sample of this app's own
recently generated prompts.
params_schema.title: CheckPromptEngineUpdatesParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of one monthly (or manually-triggered) self-review run.
return_schema.title: PromptEngineReviewResult

tools.name: list_prompt_engine_log
tools.description: Show the history of monthly Image Prompt engine self-reviews -- every past run, whether or not it found anything, newest first.

return_schema.description:
One past self-review run, newest first -- always recorded, even a

return_schema.title: PromptEngineLogEntry
